messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Semaglutide FDA approval was first granted on December 5, 2017, for the brand Ozempic.
Each semaglutide brand or formulation is FDA-approved for specific conditions and patient populations.
Triplet: ["Semaglutide", "fda approval date", "December 5, 2017"]

The relation 'fda approval date' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug received its first approval from the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) on the date specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'fda approval year': The subject drug was approved by the US FDA in the year specified by the object entity.
B. 'is approved for': The subject drug has received FDA approval for the medical condition or indication specified by the object entity.
C. 'has availability date': The subject drug has been available since the time period specified by the object entity.
D. 'has been approved by': The object entity has granted approval to the subject entity.
E. 'has onset of effect': The subject drug starts to work or shows its effect within the time period specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
